svg.title: Who attended what, and who shared events with whom
svg.desc: On the left, an 18 by 14 grid of which women attended which events. On the right, an 18 by 18 grid of how many events each pair of women shared.
svg.text: Dashed lines split the women, as listed, into the first nine and the last nine.
Events are numbered 1 to 14 across the top of the left grid.
